lines.en: I amble across the meadow.
My tail curls around a stem.
Head down, I sniff along.
My gait sways a bit.
The little ones on my back sway too.
I cross the forest's edge.
I skirt a sweet berry bush.
The grass barely bends where I step.
I climb the low slope slowly.

lines.zh: 我停一下，等背上的孩子。
lines.en: I pause for the young on my back.
My claws scrape the dry earth.
I head deeper into the brush.
I lie on my side, utterly still.
My nose still twitches faintly.
I'm playing dead, and I'm good at it.
The little ones grip tightly.
I open my mouth and bare my teeth.
I blink slowly.
I wait under the tree for night.
I curl my tail to the front.
The meadow wind is mild.
I listen to the berry bush.

lines.zh: 幼崽趴在我背上，压得我塌腰。
lines.en: The pups on my back weigh me down.
My ears droop.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖背，孩子更紧了。
lines.en: I shrug, the young cling tighter.
I wonder which way to go.
I open one eye, then close it.
This grass is soft.
I slowly tuck my claws in.

lines.zh: 我什么也不做，只是待着。
lines.en: I do nothing, I simply stay.
You've trampled my grass.
I'm not dead, just lying down.
You're too close.
I'm carrying young on my back.
Do you have berries?
I probably smell of rotting leaves.
Don't reach out, I bite.
My teeth aren't frightening.

lines.zh: 我趴在莓丛里，装成一块石头。
lines.en: I lie in the berry bush, playing dead like a stone.
I slowly lift my head to you.
Are you heading that way?
I'm waiting for you to move on.

lines.zh: 你的影子让我有点紧张。
lines.en: Your shadow makes me nervous.
I'm not easy prey.
Listen, I'm only passing by.
Don't touch my young.

lines.zh: 我倒下去了，别以为我死了。
lines.en: I drop, but don't think I'm dead.
I hold still, convincingly.
My young cried out.
I played dead. Played it well.
I shouldn't have taken that.

lines.zh: 我直接倒下去，装死给你看。
lines.en: I drop and play dead for you.

lines.zh: 重击落下，我立刻僵住装死。
lines.en: The blow lands; I go stiff and play dead.
I back into the brush.

lines.zh: 我翻过身，把肚皮露出来。
lines.en: I roll over and show my belly.
I'm going to play dead.
Sweet berries? You know me.
Put them down, I'll help myself.
That smells so sweet.
Set the sweet berries down, then step back.
I have young to feed.
A few more, please.
I'll try one first.
Better than the ones on the bush.
Where did you pick these?
I come slowly, don't rush me.
You touched my back.
My young woke up.
I clench up at once.
Don't nudge me with your toe.
You stepped on my tail.
I retreat into the grass.
That bump is no trouble.
You ruffled my fur.
One step each, no panic.

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就倒下装死。
lines.en: Closer and I'll play dead.
I still have young on my back.
That depends on the season.
Bring berries first.
I'm particular.
Not in front of my young.
I only think of that at night.
You look too eager.
Find me a good nest first.
This isn't a no, it's a delay.
The little one on my back, do not fall.
A berry, nicely dropped.
I pick it up for the young.

lines.zh: 幼崽趴在我背上，别吓它。
lines.en: A joey rides my back; do not scare it.
Too hard for me.
I tuck it under a leaf.
I'll take this little thing.
Don't think I missed it.
I nudge it along.
This smells decent.
Keep it for later.
Come closer and I'll play dead.
My young are on my back.

lines.zh: 我缩起来，看起来像尸体。
lines.en: I curl up to look like a carcass.
Touch me and I bite.
I watch your feet.
I won't run, I'll play dead.
I've used this trick many times.
What you smell is me.
I won't move, let's see what you do.
Don't step on me, I'm right here.
Mouth open, utterly still.

lines.zh: 我半睁着眼，看你走不走。
lines.en: I watch through half-closed eyes to see if you leave.
Can you hear my heartbeat?
I wait for you to lose interest.
This is my life-saving trick.
I smell of rotting leaves.
Don't roll me over.
Something still moves on my back.
A moment more and you'll leave.
I'm good at enduring.
I bite your finger.

lines.zh: 受重伤时，我会直挺挺装死。
lines.en: Badly hurt, I play dead, stiff as a board.
I bite you once, only to get free.
I turn and sweep my tail.
You pulled your hand back, didn't you?
I bite and retreat at once.
My teeth are small but sharp.
I shield the young on my back.
You're bleeding, I'm not sorry.
I drop down again.
I ease out of the grass.
The meadow gains a grey shadow.
I sniff this ground first.
I have two little ones on my back.
I shake, grass bits fall.
Plenty of berries here.
I walk over, unhurried.
A branch sways, and I'm here.
I look around, it'll do.
I raise my head, ears up.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴从灌木里抽出来。
lines.en: I pull my tail from the brush.
Hold tight, little ones.
Fire curls my fur.
I land on grass and roll half over.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我呛得直打滚。
lines.en: Water up my nose; I roll about choking.
The blast throws me into the brush.
An arrow pierces my fur.
Magic freezes my whole body.
Too hungry even to play dead.

lines.zh: 雷打到地上，我抖成一片。
lines.en: Lightning hits and I shudder all over.
No grass to lie on in the void.
